images.canvas: IIIF canvas index 48 (naive guess equal to the finding-aid's cited 'Fol. 48')
images.shows: NOT the Paget item. An unrelated 18th-century French religious-community letter (Jansenist-adjacent: 'Soeur Anne...', 'M. le Cardinal de Noailles'), stamped '209' and '42' in the corner. A second probe at canvas 54 (also not kept as an image) showed a mounted 17th-century engraved portrait ('D. Francisco Villani a Gandavo, Episcopo Tornacensi'), confirming this 268-leaf 'Melanges' volume bundles wildly heterogeneous, non-chronological material (portraits, printed factums, testaments, genealogies, autograph letters) with no simple canvas-to-folio correspondence.

note: The Paget item ('Fol. 48 -- Rosset de Fleury (testament du cardinal ; lettres autogr. de Paget, avec chiffre, 1714)', per archivesetmanuscrits.bnf.fr's item-level index) was not located by image this sweep. Gallica's Pagination service returned zero folio numbers for this ark; ContentSearch returned zero OCR hits for 'Paget'. This is a genuinely disordered miscellany, unlike Dupuy 452/468's roughly sequential letter-collections.
